Order amendment · 2026-11-10T11:11Z · claim 6765187885 · two PRs, same card, scope unchanged.

- **Why:** the maintainer asked (in this session) 「或者只对 adr 做 契约复审」. A mixed diff that touches `docs/adr/**` is Tier H as a whole and is not judged pro rata. Splitting the ADR line into its own PR is the protocol's own route.
- **Engine PR:** `claude/issue-31911-currency-parent-path`, `Fixes #31911`. It carries every item except the ADR-0144 D5 line and touches nothing under `docs/adr/**`. It lands on the seat's review.
- **ADR PR:** `claude/issue-31911-adr-0144-d5-note`, `Refs #31911`. It carries only the dated "resolved by" line citing the engine PR. It owes a contract-tier review and the maintainer's approval, and it lands after the engine PR.

Tier change · 2026-11-10T11:13Z · claim 6765187885 · `Container & model` amended.

- **Source:** the maintainer, in this session: 「31911 我切换到 opus了」. They switched the cloud dev's model by hand.
- **Reading:** `get_session` on `session_012dn2AbrAvASZ9sAUmJEy6X` shows `user_switched_model: claude-opus-5-5`, `last_served_model: claude-opus-5-5`, and effort `xhigh` (unchanged).
- **Amended line:** `model: default (opus) — maintainer override of the MANDATORY ceiling, by direct switch (quoted above); effort: xhigh`.
- **What it moves:** the engine PR has no mandated tier, so opus is its default. The ceiling was mandated only by the ADR-0144 line, which now ships in its own PR (amendment above). That one-line ADR PR still owes a contract-review-tier review before the maintainer's approval. That review stays at the ceiling, so it is the compensating control for the lowered build tier.

- **Carrier of the D5 line:** once the engine PR merges, this seat files a `domain:skills` card for ADR-0144's D5 "resolved by" line, citing the merge commit. That card is Tier H and is approved by the maintainer.
- **Delivered to the cloud dev** `session_012dn2AbrAvASZ9sAUmJEy6X`.
